testcase.name: actual alert service reaches SendGrid, escapes HTML and keeps recipients private
provider rejection does not consume cooldown; a subsequent accepted attempt does
simultaneous identical alerts share one in-flight admission and later cooldown
unconfigured alert email makes no provider request
invalid addresses, headers, credential and oversized bodies fail before any request
only202 means accepted; redirects and provider bodies never appear in diagnostics
owned HTTP server verifies serialization, bounded timeout and redirect refusal
